about:
Software Engineer with over eight years of professional experience and a lifelong passion for building software. While my core expertise is in native Android (Kotlin), I have a broad background as a mobile generalist with proficiency in iOS (Swift) and cross-platform frameworks like Flutter and React Native.

I am a versatile full-stack contributor, experienced in developing web frontends with React and Vite, as well as backends using Django and Java. My work ranges from building mission-critical apps and B2B SDKs to collaborating on AI-driven features like agentic text editors.

I have delivered high-impact solutions for both agencies and product companies across global markets. I am skilled at translating business needs into modular, scalable architecture and am experienced in collaborating with distributed teams in EST-aligned environments.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer, Mobile | Full Stack
description: Led mobile development using React Native, overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle and feature delivery of the application.
Contributed as a full-stack engineer, developing the web platform using React and Vite while managing backend logic with Django.
Collaborated on the development of the Agentic Text Editor, assisting in the integration of AI-driven features and editor functionality.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer, Mobile
description: Developed and delivered custom multi-platform mobile solutions for a diverse range of clients and industries.
Utilized cross-platform frameworks to maximize code reusability and ensure consistent functionality across iOS and Android.
Partnered with clients to translate unique business requirements into production-ready mobile applications.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer, Android
description: Developed Android applications for Owlet's baby care platform, focusing on real-time infant safety monitoring and cross-functional team collaboration.
Engineered a multiplatform charting library using Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) to visualize baby vitals across both Android and iOS.
Implemented advanced, high-performance charting features to ensure low-latency data monitoring for caregivers.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer, Android
description: Developed League's flagship mobile applications and tenant-specific solutions in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Designed and maintained a B2B SDK to facilitate third-party integrations and extend mobile platform functionality.
Authored technical documentation for the SDK to streamline adoption for external developers and partners.
Built responsive UI components and animations using Jetpack Compose to improve user engagement and interface quality.
Implemented a testing suite encompassing unit, instrumentation, and screenshot tests to ensure reliability across devices.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer, Android
description: Collaborated with an international team to develop the mission-critical Shoppers App for Cornershop's e-commerce platform.
Refactored legacy codebases to improve maintainability and reduce technical debt, resulting in faster development cycles.
Designed and implemented a modular architecture to increase code reusability and scalability across development teams.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer, Android
description: Led the Android development team for a critical client project, ensuring consistent code quality and successful deployment cycles.
Mentored team members on modern testing methodologies, increasing unit test coverage for legacy products from a baseline to over 80%.
Collaborated directly with clients to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical specifications and mobile solutions.

experiences.title: Software Engineer, Android | DevOps
description: Built high-performance Android (Java/Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) applications focused on seamless user experience and platform-specific best practices.
Developed and deployed cross-platform applications using Flutter and React Native to maximize code reusability and streamline delivery.
Automated the software development lifecycle for Android by implementing and maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines for building, testing, and deployment.

experiences.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack
description: Designed and developed a robust Android application using Java, automating key processes for clients and serving as a companion to ACCION's flagship ERP product, streamlining operations and enhancing user experience.

Engineered a high-performance web service using Java, Spring framework, Oracle SQL, and PostgreSQL, enabling seamless integration and data exchange between the Android application and backend systems, ensuring efficient and secure data management.
